name: Metaltech Products Inc.
old_description: Start cutting away at your custom fabrication needs. Request a quote from us today describing your next project.
about:
Metaltech Products Inc. operates from Lebanon, Missouri, where Darrel and Dana Bishop founded the company in 1998. With a $76,000 loan they built a 4,000‑square‑foot shop, equipped it with a hydraulic ironworker, band saw, MIG and TIG welders, a drill press and hand tools, and hired their first fabricator, Tony Evans. The business remains family‑owned; the Bishops’ sons, Blake and Brice, now work in the operation.

The shop provides full‑cycle custom metal fabrication: design and product development, laser cutting, punch‑press and automated sawing, forming on four press brakes, CNC and manual machining, MIG, TIG, robotic MIG (GMAW) and resistance spot welding, powder coating for parts up to 26 feet long, and assembly. Two facilities total roughly 173,000 square feet (60,000 sq ft from a 2008 expansion plus a 113,000 sq ft building added in 2015). Quality is managed under ISO 9001:2015, and welding personnel hold American Welding Society certifications.

Metaltech serves OEM manufacturers across a range of sectors, including automotive, furniture and appliance makers—industries specifically noted for spot‑welded components. Customers engage the company for everything from concept sketches and prototypes to production‑volume component parts and pre‑assembled sub‑assemblies.

Darrel Bishop started the company after leading an outsourcing team at Electrovert and recognizing a gap in the supply of large machine frames. The stated mission emphasizes innovation, continuous improvement and profitability, delivered through a documented quality system and a workforce that includes second‑generation family members.
